records.text: Forensic technician Michael Cormier was involved with Andrew Breitbart's autopsy and later died from military-grade arsenic poisoning.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I kid you not, his name was Michael Cormier. He was 61 years old. And for whatever reason, he decided after being involved with this autopsy to ingest military-grade arsenic poisoning.

verification.notes: Cormier died from arsenic poisoning, but LAPD and the coroner's office explicitly said he did not work on Breitbart's autopsy and had no connection to it. No reliable source supports the 'military-grade' qualifier.

sources.title: No Answers in Death of Technician Linked to Andrew Breitbart
sources.relevance: Reports arsenic poisoning while explaining that official records did not connect Cormier to Breitbart's autopsy.

sources.title: Coroner's office speaks on Breitbart mystery
sources.relevance: Quotes LAPD and coroner officials explicitly denying that Cormier worked on the Breitbart autopsy.
